transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavier tasks for 1 month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I was also wondering when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful to know, thank you. I'm finding myself very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Some sensitivity to light can be normal as your eye adjusts, and if it just seems brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity especially with a red, painful eye, is not normal and may need assessment. Do you have any other questions?
